digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality gate and inbound_fields module location
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root because it is shared by both jira and jira_datacenter adapters while the J7 contract forbids sibling-adapter imports in either direction
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the J7 sibling-adapter seal that jira_datacenter cannot import from jira
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) are not permitted to import from the family layer
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption for inbound_fields.py documents a permanent architectural constraint rather than temporary relocation debt
the module's by-path lazy-load of adapters/jira/adf.py cannot be laundered through a path-string load to satisfy the AST gate if relocated to jira_family
